tasks.title: Add and test the greet helper
tasks.acceptance_criterion: src/greet.js exports greet(name), greet("Ada") returns exactly "Hello, Ada!", test/greet.test.js covers the helper, and npm test completes successfully without modifying any other file.
tasks.deterministic_validity_check: node --experimental-default-type=module --input-type=module -e "import { greet } from './src/greet.js'; if (greet('Ada') !== 'Hello, Ada!') process.exit(1)"
patch_requirements: Export greet using the module style established by src/capitalize.js.
Interpolate names exactly as provided without validation, trimming, or capitalization.
Add focused test coverage for the required Ada behavior.
Do not modify package.json, src/capitalize.js, or any other file.
